constructor: Normalized Miller coefficient binary recurrence; g=Z(R)+c*y(R)*(alpha+beta*c*(x(R)-x(P))), c=Z(P)/y(P), normalized nonzero Legendre character.
cost: Setup O(log r), predicate O(log r+log p), conditional recovery O(log r*(log r+log p)) plus public verification; separately charge trial-division certification and public coordinate census. Search charges all40 candidate arms; setup reused over13targets and charged once per group.
positive_control_scope: Truth-half is constructed with O(r) verifier scalar enumeration. It tests the validator and conditional recovery only, not candidate success.
pass: One fixed integer template defined and correct for all13targets/all12bases/all10views, exact two-pulse law, primitive/covariance controls and publicly verified conditional recovery. Finite exact result only; no global proof/novelty inference.
failure: Retain exact first counterexample, full outcomes/residuals and undefined reasons per fixedtemplate. Ifall40fail stopthisfixedgrammar; nofittedreplacement, nofreshcohort. Software/infrastructurefault isnotmathematicalfailure.
